arguments.body:
Hi John,

Thanks for the meeting. Key decisions: phase‑two rollout starts 10 Feb 2026, weekly status calls will be on Tuesdays at 10:00, and the reporting dashboard will use the revised metric definitions.

Action items:
- Dana will circulate the revised rollout timeline by 9 Jan 2026.
- Priya will confirm dashboard metric definitions with the data team.
- All participants will prepare the phase‑two risk register before the next status call.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
